what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Cameroon by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 953875 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 1004257.
Refugees from Cameroon live mainly in Nigeria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory, with Ambazonia insurgents, from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government with JAS in several years from 2015 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in several years from 2015.
Floods, storms, wildfires and mass movements are the disasters recorded for Cameroon in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 40000 in 2014 to a peak of 1043924 in 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2018.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 50382 fewer internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Cameroon people moved to.
